sentences.japanese: 客人たちはその幸せな夫婦が末永く裕福な人生を送る事を祈った。
sentences.english: The guests wished the happy couple a long and prosperous life.

sentences.japanese: 我々は全員ひざまずいて祈りを捧げた。
sentences.english: We all knelt down to pray.

sentences.japanese: 家族のご多幸を祈ります。
sentences.english: May you and your family be happy.

sentences.japanese: 雨が正午前にはやむよう祈っていたのですが。
sentences.english: We had hoped that the rain would stop before noon.
